method: Built-in image generation; supplied artwork used as compositing input

variants.name: technical-white
variants.prompt:
Use case: compositing.
Asset type: horizontal GitHub README banner, approximately 3:1 aspect ratio, high quality.
Input image 1 is the user's original Takeuchi skid steer and HDRS24 rock saw illustration to preserve and incorporate.
Primary request: create a formal engineering project banner.
Composition: clearly legible text in the left half, supplied machine artwork in the right half; preserve the full cab and rock saw wheel without cropping away identifying features. Match the ink and watercolor equipment artwork. Generous balanced margins.
Text verbatim, large uppercase two-line title: "ROCK SAW" and "WATER CONTROL". Small subtitle: "TAKEUCHI TL12".
Constraints: preserve original machine proportions, attachment arrangement, red white and graphite equipment colors, and mechanical details; do not add hardware, hydraulic lines, people, invented logos, claims, badges or watermarks. No extra text. This is an art banner, not a wiring diagram. Warm white paper background, dark graphite precise sans-serif type, thin restrained muted red rule. Clean archival technical editorial design, original paper/sketch texture, minimal.
